alessandra: Planning a migration roll on 00:00-02:00 UTC. We'll run mig_2026_04_01_w2 across shard 6100-6450. Target initial throttle 30% with 10m staggers. Need preflight lock check + an operator holdpoint at +12m.

craig: What's our abort policy? I want explicit SLOs for rollback vs slow-mode.

alessandra: Abort if any of: (1) rolling error rate > 0.8% for 4m, (2) any single node sees >40s avg lock_wait over 2m, (3) live API p99 spikes > 2.5x baseline for 3m. Otherwise we reduce throttle to 10% and extend staggers by 10m.

li: App runtime pinned to `api@v2.4.0-rc3` during this window. QA verified read compatibility; writes behind feature-flag rollout. Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/2.4.0-rc3/notes (see Operational -> DB migration notes).

ops-bot: [preflight] quiet-window check scheduled at T-15m. Ops-sre please confirm drain and replica snapshot readiness.

qa-bot: running smoke tests against canary after each wave. If `regression_failures > 0` we flag and hold.

deploybot: [automated] queued migration mig_2026_04_01_w2 start_in=15m shards=6100-6450 throttle=0.3 stagger=10m holdpoint=+12m alert_contacts=[@craig,@alessandra] To abort: `/deploybot abort mig_2026_04_01_w2 --reason <text>`.

craig: Can we add a lightweight lockwatch probe that samples `pg_locks` every 30s and posts a short summary? If pending_locks > 30 OR blocked_queries > 5 we'll auto-pause.

alessandra: good call. li can you drop a script snippet? we'll wire to deploybot hook. Also confirm we have a runbook blurb for oncall with the abort commands.

li: pasted snippet:
```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
PENDING=$(psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted;")
BLOCKED=$(psql -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity a JOIN pg_locks l ON a.pid=l.pid WHERE NOT l.granted;")
if [ "$PENDING" -gt 30 ] || [ "$BLOCKED" -gt 5 ]; then
  curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":"lockwatch: pending='$PENDING' blocked='$BLOCKED'"}' https://hooks.internal/deploybot
fi
```

deploybot: Watchhook registered: lockwatch -> deploybot.signals. auto_pause_threshold = pending>30 || blocked>5.

ops-bot: quiet-window confirmed by ops-sre. Replica sampling enabled and retention increased for pg_stat_activity for 20m.

alessandra: final checklist: 1) lockwatch in place (li) 2) pinned runtime verified (li) 3) holdpoint at +12m and alerting (craig) 4) QA smoke gating (qa-bot). If green, we start at T.

craig: I'll be oncall for the window. Also added a manual abort alias on my laptop: `alias abortmig='deploybot abort mig_2026_04_01_w2 --reason "manual abort"'`

alessandra: launching in 5m. Posting start when deploybot flips.
